diagnosis: The Kafka consumer trusts an unauthenticated message header X-Target-Tenant and indexes retrieved documents directly into that target tenant's search index without verifying that KnowledgeDocument.tenant_id == target_tenant_id. An attacker emitting reindex events can inject other tenants' sensitive knowledge documents into their own searchable index.

corrected_code:
async def consume_search_reindex_stream(consumer: AIOKafkaConsumer, es_client: AsyncElasticsearch, db_session_factory):
    async for msg in consumer:
        headers = {k: v.decode("utf-8") for k, v in msg.headers}
        target_tenant_id = headers.get("X-Target-Tenant")
        data = json.loads(msg.value.decode("utf-8"))
        doc_ids = data.get("document_ids", [])

        async with db_session_factory() as session:
            stmt = select(KnowledgeDocument).where(
                KnowledgeDocument.id.in_(doc_ids),
                KnowledgeDocument.tenant_id == target_tenant_id
            )
            result = await session.execute(stmt)
            docs = result.scalars().all()

        if not docs:
            continue

        actions = [
            {"_index": f"tenant_{target_tenant_id}_search", "_id": str(d.id), "_source": {"title": d.title, "body": d.body}}
            for d in docs
        ]
        await es_client.bulk(operations=actions)
